SQL:
-- Find actors with Shahrukh number 2
-- Step 1: Find Shah Rukh Khan's PID
-- Step 2: Find all movies he acted in
-- Step 3: Find all actors who acted with him (direct co-stars)
-- Step 4: Find all actors who acted with those co-stars (but not with Shah Rukh directly)
-- Step 5: Count them

WITH shahrukh_pid AS (
    SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE Name = 'Shah Rukh Khan'
),
shahrukh_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE PID IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
),
direct_co_stars AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM M_Cast 
    WHERE MID IN (SELECT MID FROM shahrukh_movies) 
    AND PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
),
actors_with_co_stars AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t1.PID 
    FROM M_Cast t1
    WHERE t1.MID IN (SELECT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE PID IN (SELECT PID FROM direct_co_stars))
    AND t1.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM actors_with_co_stars
